## Executive Summary
Autonomous systems and forward-deployed automation engineer with an M.Tech in Control and Instrumentation from MNNIT Allahabad and a B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering from RCOEM Nagpur. Operates at the intersection of embedded hardware, deterministic edge runtimes, real-time computer vision, and industrial systems automation. Lead author of peer-reviewed edge-perception research published in IEEE Xplore (Document ID: 10627276). Proven track record of architecting production-grade client-side engines executing under 50ms latency (npl-automation.pages.dev), software-defined radio (SDR) spectral sensing pipelines for UAV RF classification, and ROS2 embedded robotics control stacks.
